1.why: src/X.cpp:116-117, scaled by a tenth and added to the fold knob

comment: The mash knob is configured with its ends the wrong way round, 23 as the minimum and -4 as the maximum (src/X.cpp:78), so turning it clockwise coarsens the quantisation rather than the other way; the value is used as two to the power minus it, which is a step of two to the -23 volts at one end and 16V at the other. The truncation error is then put through the shaper three more times with the coefficients 4, -6 and 4 at four times the sample rate, which is the over-sampling (src/X.cpp:118-126). The panel prints FOLD, KIND, MASH, WET, IN, MFLD and OUT.
